name: Laghu Musli Pak

sections.introduction: Laghu Musli Pak enhances sexual power and it comprises of Shatavari, Ashwagandha and various other herbs. Musli is a substitute for Viagra, it enhances the sperm count and aids in erection also. Musli Pak helps to cure anorexia, emaciation, anemia etc. It enhances male and female fertility and helps in giving birth to a healthy baby.
sections.ingredients:
Safed musli (Chlorophytum borivilianum) 
 Clarified butter 
 Dry ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Black cardamom (Amomum subulatum) 
 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) 
 Tej patra (Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) 
 Chitrak (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) 
 Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Clove (Syzygium aromaticum) 
 Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) 
 Kharenti (Malvastrum coromandelianum) 
 Kaunch seeds (Mucuns pruriens) 
 Semal resin (Bombax ceiba) 
 Vanshlochan (Bamboo manna) 
 Akarkara (Anacyclus pyrethrum) 

 Method of Preparation 
 Prepare a concoction of Chlorophytum borivilianum and add the remaining ingredients in it and heat the mixture till you attain a semisolid consistency. Remove it from flame and let it cool down. When it is cool to the touch add honey in it.
sections.properties_of_laghu_musli_pak: Laghu Musli Pak is an Ayurvedic medicine meant to manage the various sexual health problems. It is very effective medicine for general debility, weakness and fatigue as it helps to maintain the strength and energy in body. In case of male sexual problems use of this medicine is very beneficial. Laghu musli pak manages the various problems like premature ejaculation, erectile dysfunction, and night fall, loss of desire of sex, sexual weakness and infertility. Herbs used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with aphrodisiac properties which help to improve the libido and enhance sexual desire. Moreover, this medicine enhances sperm production and also improves the quality of sperms. For hair problems use of this medicine is quite good. It helps to strengthen the hair roots and prevents the hair fall. This is an effective medicine to relieve the problem of coughing in respiratory complications. It clears the mucous or phlegm from air ways and eases the process of breathing.

Laghu Musli Pak 
 Introduction 
 Laghu Musli Pak enhances sexual power and it comprises of Shatavari, Ashwagandha and various other herbs. Musli is a substitute for Viagra, it enhances the sperm count and aids in erection also. Musli Pak helps to cure anorexia, emaciation, anemia etc. It enhances male and female fertility and helps in giving birth to a healthy baby. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Safed musli (Chlorophytum borivilianum) 
 Clarified butter 
 Dry ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Black cardamom (Amomum subulatum) 
 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) 
 Tej patra (Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) 
 Chitrak (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) 
 Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)

 Kaunch seeds (Mucuns pruriens) 
 Semal resin (Bombax ceiba) 
 Vanshlochan (Bamboo manna) 
 Akarkara (Anacyclus pyrethrum) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Prepare a concoction of Chlorophytum borivilianum and add the remaining ingredients in it and heat the mixture till you attain a semisolid consistency. Remove it from flame and let it cool down. When it is cool to the touch add honey in it. 
 Properties of Laghu Musli Pak 
 Laghu Musli Pak is an Ayurvedic medicine meant to manage the various sexual health problems. It is very effective medicine for general debility, weakness and fatigue as it helps to maintain the strength and energy in body. In case of male sexual problems use of this medicine is very beneficial. Laghu musli pak manages the various problems like premature ejaculation, erectile dysfunction, and night fall, loss of desire of sex, sexual weakness and infertility. Herbs used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with aphrodisiac properties which help to improve the libido and enhance sexual desire. Moreover, this medicine enhances sperm production and also improves the quality of sperms. For hair problems use of this medicine is quite good. It helps to strengthen the hair roots and prevents the hair fall. This is an effective medicine to relieve the problem of coughing in respiratory complications. It clears the mucous or phlegm from air ways and eases the process of breathing. 
 Indications 
 
 Libido 
 Sexual vigor and stamina 
 Premature ejaculation 
 Energy 
 Hair fall 
 Cough 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 6-12 grams twice daily with warm milk. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
